content.title: Back end review
content.body:
🚀 Refined GitHub Issue (Kanban Card)
Title: [BACKEND] - Project Architecture & Schema Review

🎯 Goal Perform a general review of the project and summarize your understanding of the architecture, tech stack, and business purpose.

📂 Context & Files

app/ (models and controllers)
config/ (routes and application config)
Dockerfile & 

docker-compose.yml
db/schema.rb
🛠 Requirements

Identify all services used (Redis, Postgres, Sidekiq, etc.).
Confirm the exact Ruby and Rails versions found in the Dockerfile and Gemfile.
Explain, in your own words, what is the primary purpose of the ordenapp system based on the database schema.
⚠️ Pre-Programming Check (Crucial) AGENT INSTRUCTIONS: Do not implement any code changes. Instead, provide your full report (Services, Versions, Schema Analysis) inside a === QUESTION === block directed to the Project Manager.

✅ Success Criteria

 Agent delivers a clear summary of services used.
 Agent identifies correct Ruby/Rails versions.
 Agent explains the logic behind the current schema.rb.
